======================================================
 Md. Shakil son of Md. Ghison Village- Idgahpatri Narayanpur Ps- Manihar  Dist- Katihar  ... .
 Versus  The State of Bihar

For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Raghvendra Kumar Singh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Md. Shakir Ahmad  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUNIL KUMAR PANWAR
ORAL ORDER 2 16-05-2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant.

2. The petitioner has filed application for grant of regular bail in connection with Manihari P.S.
Case. No. 140 of 2023 and offences under Sections 341, 323, 325, 326, 498A, 504, 506, 120B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per prosecution case, petitioner along with his family members demanded five lacs rupees from the victim(informant).
Due to non-fulfillment of demand, they started torturing and also assaulting her.
Petitioner assaulted her mother due to which her hand was broken.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and he has committed no offence.
He is Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.31380 of 2024(2) dt.16-05-2024 the husband of the victim/informant due to which he has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is further submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is ready to keep his wife with dignity and honour.
A statement has been made in para-3 of this petition that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.

Moreover,
the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 19.07.2023.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the informant submits opposite party No.2 (informant/victim) is ready to live with the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts that both parties are ready to live together and lead their conjugal life , this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on provisional bail for a period of one and half months.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on provisional bail in connection with Manihari P.S. Case No. 140 of 2023 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate,
Katihar.

7. Put up this case on 05.07.2024.
8.

In the meantime, both parties are directed to make effort to settle their matrimonial dispute amicably and in this Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.31380 of 2024(2) dt.16-05-2024 respect learned counsel for the petitioner will produce joint affidavit on the next fixed date.

(Sunil Kumar Panwar, J) Shubham/-
